<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Fon Takip Dashboard</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f4f6fb; --card:#ffffff; --text:#0f172a; --muted:#64748b; --border:#e2e8f0;
  --accent:#4f46e5; --accent-soft:#eef2ff; --hover:#f1f5f9; --neg:#dc2626; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.05),0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
  box-sizing:border-box; padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#0b1020; --card:#131a2e; --text:#e6e9f5; --muted:#94a3b8; --border:#243049;
    --accent:#818cf8; --accent-soft:#1e2447; --hover:#1a2340; --neg:#f87171; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0b1020; --card:#131a2e; --text:#e6e9f5; --muted:#94a3b8; --border:#243049;
  --accent:#818cf8; --accent-soft:#1e2447; --hover:#1a2340; --neg:#f87171; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:"Inter","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
.wrap{max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 48px}
header{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:16px}
h1{font-size:24px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.sub{color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.btn,.seg button{font:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer}
.btn:hover,.seg button:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.btn.primary{border-color:var(--accent)}
.seg{display:inline-flex;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
.seg button{border:0;background:transparent;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px}
.seg button.on{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.pop{position:relative}
.popbox{position:absolute;z-index:30;top:calc(100% + 6px);left:0;width:min(420px,92vw);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:10px;display:none}
.popbox.open{display:block}
.popbox input[type=search]{width:100%}
.flist{max-height:300px;overflow:auto;margin-top:8px}
.flist label{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:6px 6px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.flist label:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.flist b{min-width:38px}
.flist span{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
input[type=search]{font:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;outline:none}
input[type=search]:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.row-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.kpi{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.kpi .l{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.kpi .v{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kpi .s{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,420px) 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
@media (max-width:900px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-width:0}
.card h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 12px}
.donutwrap{position:relative;max-width:360px;margin:0 auto}
svg.donut{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.slice{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s;transform-origin:150px 150px}
.slice:hover{transform:scale(1.025)}
.dim{opacity:.28}
.center{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;padding:0 20%}
.center .big{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.center .sm{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.note{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-top:10px}
.tablewrap{overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--card)}
td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:top}
th.r,td.r{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
tr.clickable{cursor:pointer}
tr.clickable:hover td{background:var(--hover)}
tr.sel td{background:var(--accent-soft)}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:baseline}
.bar{height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--border);margin-top:5px;min-width:90px;overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:3px}
.neg{color:var(--neg)}
.detailhead{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.detailhead h2{margin:0}
.chip{display:inline-block;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.empty{color:var(--muted);padding:28px 8px;text-align:center}
.desc{color:var(--muted);max-width:420px}
.scroll{max-height:520px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px}
.scroll table td:first-child,.scroll table th:first-child{padding-left:12px}
.tip{position:fixed;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;max-width:260px;display:none;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.modalbg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(2,6,23,.55);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:50;padding:16px}
.modalbg.open{display:flex}
.modal{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;max-width:560px;width:100%;max-height:86vh;overflow:auto;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.modal h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.modal .close{float:right;margin:-6px -6px 0 8px}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
.mgrid div{background:var(--bg);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px}
.mgrid small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.mgrid b{font-size:16px}
.descbox{background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin:8px 0 14px}
.descbox small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:4px}
.others{font-size:13px}
.others div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}

.ctrls{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.tog{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}
.tog input[type=date]{font:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 8px}
.badge{display:inline-block;min-width:16px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;margin-left:6px}
.sumline{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;margin:0 0 8px}
.sumline b{color:var(--text)}
.modal.wide{max-width:820px}
.back{float:left;margin:-6px 8px 0 -6px}
.sect{margin:16px 0 8px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
.gray{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.xbtn{border:0;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;padding:0 0 0 6px}
/* sekmeler */
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:0 0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.tabs button{font:inherit;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);background:none;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;padding:10px 16px;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:-1px}
.tabs button:hover{color:var(--text)}
.tabs button.on{color:var(--accent);border-bottom-color:var(--accent)}
.tabs .arrow{margin-left:4px}
/* tablo araç çubuğu */
.gtbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 6px;min-height:26px}
.gtbar .sp{flex:1}
.ghost{font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);background:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:3px 9px;cursor:pointer}
.ghost:hover{background:var(--hover);color:var(--text)}
.ghost.on{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
th.sortable{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.arr{color:var(--border);font-size:10px}
th.sortable:hover .arr{color:var(--muted)}
.arr.on{color:var(--accent)!important}
.gts thead tr:first-child th{height:34px}
.gts.withf tr.fr th{top:34px;padding:4px 6px;background:var(--card);text-transform:none;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0}
th.fl input{width:100%;min-width:72px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 6px;outline:none}
th.fl input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.pair{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
th.fl .pair input{min-width:58px;width:62px}
tfoot td{border-top:2px solid var(--border);border-bottom:0;background:var(--card)}
tr.hl td{background:var(--accent-soft)}
/* sayfa 2 */
.p2intro{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:14px}
.p2intro h2{font-size:20px;margin:0}
.p2intro p{margin:2px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.k2grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,340px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:900px){.k2grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.k2grid #kListCard{position:sticky;top:12px}
@media (max-width:900px){.k2grid #kListCard{position:static}}
#kListCard input[type=search]{width:100%}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:10px 0}
.chipbtn{font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.chipbtn span{color:var(--muted);margin-left:2px}
.chipbtn.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.chipbtn.on span{color:#e0e7ff}
.klistbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:13px}
.klistbar select{font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:4px 6px}
.klist{max-height:560px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px}
@media (max-width:900px){.klist{max-height:300px}}
.kitem{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer}
.kitem:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.kitem:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.kitem.sel{background:var(--accent-soft);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent)}
.kitem .kn{min-width:0}
.kitem .kv{white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.p2head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:12px}
.p2head h2{font-size:20px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.kpis.sm{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.kpis.sm .kpi{padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:none}
.kpis.sm .kpi .v{font-size:17px}
.qwrap{overflow-x:auto;margin:6px 0 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 4px;background:var(--card)}
.qbar{cursor:pointer}.qbar.dim{opacity:.35}
.ptabs{margin-bottom:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.fslice{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s;transform-origin:150px 150px}
.fslice:hover{transform:scale(1.025)}.fslice.dim{opacity:.28}
.tag{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;padding:1px 9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.tag.ok{background:rgba(16,185,129,.16);color:#059669}.tag.warn{background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);color:var(--neg)}.tag.info{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .tag.ok{color:#34d399}}
.chk{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);align-items:flex-start}
.chk:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}.chk .tag{min-width:26px;text-align:center;margin-top:2px}
details{margin-top:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px}
details summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
details[open] summary{margin-bottom:8px}
.fbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;padding:12px 14px}
.fbar select,.fbar input[type=search]{font:inherit;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:7px 10px;outline:none;max-width:240px}
.fbar input[type=search]{min-width:200px;flex:1}
.fbar select:focus,.fbar input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.noteBox{margin-bottom:16px;border-left:4px solid var(--accent)}
.noteBox h2{font-size:14px;margin:0 0 6px}
.noteBox ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;color:var(--muted)}
.noteBox li{margin:3px 0}
.noteBox li b{color:var(--text)}
.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
@media (max-width:1000px){.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.hb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(110px,230px) 1fr minmax(84px,120px);gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:5px 6px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.hb:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.hl{min-width:0}.hl b,.hl .gray{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.hbar{height:10px;background:var(--border);border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}.hbar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:5px}
.hv{text-align:right;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.tabs{overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap}
.chiprow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.sp{flex:1}

.tag.gray{background:var(--hover);color:var(--muted)}
.yslice{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s;transform-origin:150px 150px}.yslice:hover{transform:scale(1.025)}.yslice.dim{opacity:.28}
.bub{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .15s}.bub:hover{fill-opacity:.9}.bub.dim{opacity:.3}
.legend{margin-top:10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px 14px}
@media (max-width:700px){.legend{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.lg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;padding:3px 4px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer}.lg:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.lg .ln{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.lg .lv{color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.legendrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 14px;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px}.lgi{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.stk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(110px,210px) 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:5px 6px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.stk:hover,.stk.on{background:var(--hover)}.stk.on{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent)}
.stk .hl b,.stk .hl .gray{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.stkbar{display:flex;height:16px;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--border)}.stkbar i{display:block;height:100%}.stkbar i:hover{filter:brightness(1.15)}
.mbar{height:4px;background:var(--border);border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:3px;min-width:60px}.mbar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:3px}
#adjSeg button{font-size:12px}
.tabs button{padding:10px 13px}.kpi .v{font-size:20px}.disc{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic;max-width:980px}th.fl select.chsel{width:100%;min-width:92px;max-width:190px;text-overflow:ellipsis;font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 4px;outline:none;cursor:pointer}th.fl select.chsel:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}.fbtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;vertical-align:middle;width:20px;height:20px;margin-left:4px;padding:0;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:none;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}
.fbtn:hover{background:var(--hover);color:var(--text)}.fbtn.on{color:#fff;background:var(--accent)}
.gtpop{position:fixed;z-index:80;min-width:230px;max-width:360px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(2,6,23,.28);padding:8px}
.gtph{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;padding:4px 8px 6px}
.gtpop input[type=search]{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:6px 9px;outline:none;margin-bottom:6px}
.gtpl{max-height:300px;overflow:auto}
.gtpi{padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;white-space:normal}
.gtpi:hover{background:var(--hover)}.gtpi.sel{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.desc.wide{min-width:250px;white-space:normal}#yb_top{height:460px;overflow-y:scroll;overflow-x:hidden;padding-right:4px}
@supports (-moz-appearance:none){#yb_top{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--muted) var(--border)}}
#yb_top .hb{height:46px;box-sizing:border-box}
#yb_top::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px}
#yb_top::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--border);border-radius:6px}
#yb_top::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--muted);border-radius:6px}
#yb_top::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--accent)}
.ozcard{margin-bottom:16px}
.ozhead{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 12px;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:10px}
.ozhead h2{margin:0;font-size:15px}.ozhead .sp{flex:1}
.ozdelta{font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.ozlink{font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.ozlink:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.ozrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr 100px;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;margin:6px 0;color:var(--muted)}
.ozrow b{color:var(--text);text-align:right;font-weight:600}
.oztrack{height:10px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--border);overflow:hidden}.oztrack i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:5px}
.oz2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:12px}
@media (max-width:700px){.oz2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ozli{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:5px 2px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px}
.ozli:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.ozneg{color:var(--neg)}.ozpos{color:#059669}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .ozpos{color:#34d399}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .ozpos{color:#34d399}
.ozleg{cursor:pointer}.ozleg:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.lgi i{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:5px}
.ozstat{border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:12px;padding-top:10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:6px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.ozbig{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ozkt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(130px,200px) 1fr 100px;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;margin:6px 0}.ozkt b{text-align:right}
.ozfoot{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 24px}
.oztop3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;align-items:stretch}.oztop3>.card{margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}.oztop3 .ozhead h2{font-size:14px}.oztop3 .ozbig{font-size:28px}@media(max-width:1100px){.oztop3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ozcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;min-width:0}.ozcol>.card{margin:0}.ozcol>.card:last-child{flex:1}
.oztbls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:10px;align-items:start}
@media (max-width:560px){.oztbls{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ozmini{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
.ozmini caption{caption-side:top;text-align:left;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:0 0 4px}
.ozmini th{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;font-weight:600;padding:3px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.ozmini td{padding:3px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.ozmini .r{text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.ozmini tr.clk{cursor:pointer}.ozmini tr.clk:hover td{background:var(--hover)}
.kpimini{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.kpi.mini{flex:1;padding:8px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.kpi.mini .l{font-size:11px}
.kpi.mini .v{font-size:19px;margin-top:2px}
.gtpi.mi{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}.gtpi.mi input{accent-color:var(--accent)}
.gtpa{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:0 8px 6px}.gtpa .ghost{font-size:12px;padding:3px 8px}
.gtcnt{margin-left:6px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.chsel.mbtn{width:100%;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.tag.neg{background:#fee2e2;color:#b91c1c}
.nw{white-space:nowrap}
.tag.warn{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}
.kpi.kc{text-align:left}
.kpi.kc .l{line-height:1.25}
.kpi.kc .v{margin-top:4px}
.kpi.kc .s{font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;margin-top:5px}
